title: Bounded Buffer Problem
body:
Shared [[Array]] (buffer) of length $n$.
*Threads:*
- $\leq 1$ producer
- $\leq 1$ consumer
*Semaphore used:*
- Mutex       -> init to $1$
- slot_avail  -> init to $n$ (when slot_avail == 0, buffer is full and producer should go to sleep)
- item_avail -> init to $0$ (when item_avail == 0, )
```C
while(1) {
	item = produce_item(); //remainder section
	
	sem_wait(&slot_avail); //wait for buffer space
	sem_Wait(&mutex);      //enter critical section
	...                    //enqueue item
	sem_post(&mutex);      //exit critical section
	sem_post(&data_avail); //signal producer
	
	consume_item(item);
}
```
